title: Scott Nolan - SpaceX, Founders Fund, and Rebuilding American Uranium Enrichment - [Invest Like the Best, EP.467]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Scott Nolan spent 12 years at Founders Fund looking for the most important problems that no one else was funding.
reader_summary.overview: Scott Nolan spent 12 years at Founders Fund looking for the most important problems that no one else was funding. Then he found a problem so critical, and so ignored, that he couldn't find a company to back. General Matter is rebuilding US uranium enrichment.

key_points.text: The United States was the world leader in enrichment through the 1980s and then stopped entirely.
Today roughly a quarter of US enriched uranium comes from Russia, a ban on those imports takes full effect in 2028.
Scott believes enrichment is the single bottleneck to a nuclear future, and that the window to solve it is narrow.
